summary: Completed all 8 phases: state-write.sh extended with --state-file and --init; every hand-rolled archive/vault state.json write site converted across commands/task.md, commands/todo.md, skill-todo/SKILL.md, archive-task.sh, and vault-operation.sh (including vault-operation.sh's two former unprotected LIVE specs/state.json writes); task-lock.md's stale residual-surface note corrected; verification bar closed against a re-measured, five-item exclusion list (one item added during Phase 8 beyond the plan's declared four). All three state-write test suites pass (18/18 cases total), backward compatibility confirmed across 41 pre-existing callers, check-task-references.sh and check-extension-docs.sh both exit 0.
decisions_made: D1-D7 applied as written in the plan (see plan's Resolved Design Decisions section).

Phase 8 finding: the declared four-item verification exclusion list needed a fifth item -- jq-escaping-workarounds.md's isolated 'Test Script' section (specs/tmp/test-state.json), an illustrative fixture demonstrating raw jq escaping mechanics, never a production state-file write site. Added with a stated reason rather than silently widening or ignoring the residual hit.

Phase 8 finding: the plan's scoped verification grep does not match archive-task.sh's/vault-operation.sh's ORIGINAL hand-rolled sites at baseline, because those sites redirected through shell variables ($ARCHIVE_STATE_FILE, $state_json) rather than literal state.json/archive/state.json text. The grep is therefore not a meaningful regression proof for those two scripts specifically; their correctness was verified directly instead (bash -n, --dry-run smoke test, and a full no-op-then-confirmed fixtured run).

Re-measured (not assumed) out-of-scope surface: 115 hand-rolled specs/state.json sites across 50 files in non-core extensions (vs. the plan's 128/56 estimate from planning); 41 total state-write.sh callers (vs. the research report's ~24 estimate).

check-extension-docs.sh transiently flagged 'deployed script content drift' for vault-operation.sh (deploy tree lagging the source-store edit) -- resolving that is deploy-headless.sh's remit, explicitly restricted to skill-orchestrate's own inter-cycle redeploy checkpoint per that script's header, not a general-implementation-agent action. It cleared on its own before the final Phase 8 verification run without this agent invoking that script. Fixed the two genuinely in-scope check-extension-docs.sh failures (stale index-entries.json line_count values) via generate-context-line-counts.sh --write.
